channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: A quarter of NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 showed signs of CTE
item.description: At least one in four NFL players who died from 2016 to 2021 had evidence of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) at the time of death.

item.title: Extreme temperatures linked to higher heart failure hospitalization risk
item.description: Short-term exposure to cold spells, lower ambient temperatures, and higher ambient temperatures can increase the risk of heart failure hospitalization.

item.title: Giardia cases in England reach highest level in nearly a decade
item.description: UKHSA data shows a 11.4% rise in cases in 2025, with adults aged 30-39 and Londoners most affected.

item.title: Digital pets increase daily activity by over 20%, study finds
item.description: A master's thesis at NTNU suggests that a mobile game can make physical activity more enjoyable and boost daily activity levels.
